source_law.title: Stopping, standing or parking prohibited in specified places (1)(i)
source_law.text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Within 50 feet of the nearest rail of a railroad.
